title: Canvas Learning System Public Annotation Ledger v2 Draft
description: Strict public projection. JSON Schema validates shape and single-record state combinations; the declared invariant checker validates referential integrity, replay, DAG, digest equality, and coverage. Private paths, raw annotation text, private prompts/replies, reversible private hashes, approval text, secrets, and private locator mappings are forbidden.

manifest_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A01-MANIFEST/v2\0 || canonical public A01 manifest payload bytes) under hash_profile_id; the written \0 denotes one NUL byte.

source_occurrences.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by occurrence_id ascending. The checker rejects duplicate occurrence_id values even when the remaining object differs.

atomic_annotations.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by annotation_id ascending. The checker rejects duplicate annotation_id values and in-place historical rewrites.

external_review_batches.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by batch_id ascending. The checker rejects duplicate batch_id values.

external_review_waivers.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by waiver_id ascending. The checker rejects duplicate waiver_id values.

events.description: Canonical sequence array; order is ledger_sequence and must be exactly contiguous 1..N. It must not be re-sorted by any other key.

projection_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A02-PROJECTION/v2\0 || JCS(UTF-8 ledger projection)) after omitting projection_payload_sha256 and the complete invariant_check object. The written \0 denotes one NUL byte. The checker must recompute it; a lexical hash match is insufficient.

hashProfileId.description: Frozen CLS v2 canonical hash profile. Normalize JSON string values and keys to Unicode NFC, serialize with RFC 8785/JCS to UTF-8, and prepend the artifact domain bytes frozen by contract section 5.4. A payload hash omits only its own hash field; projection_payload_sha256 also omits invariant_check. Private artifacts use HMAC-SHA256(K_audit_local, domain_bytes || canonical_or_raw_private_bytes), never a public raw digest. Commitment serialization uses hmac-sha256:<TAG>:<lowercase hex>, with exact mappings CLS_PRIVATE_CONTENT_v2 -> CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2\0, CLS_EXTERNAL_PACK_v2 -> CLS/EXTERNAL-PACK/v2\0, and CLS_APPROVAL_RECEIPT_v2 -> CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2\0. The written \0 denotes one NUL byte. Field-specific or v1 domains are invalid. K_audit_local, key identifiers, private bytes, and locator mappings never enter this public projection.

sourceContentCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

sourceAnchorCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

privateEvidenceCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

redactionApprovalCommitment.description: Trusted receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

deferredApprovalCommitment.description: Trusted receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalPackCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/EXTERNAL-PACK/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalApprovalReceiptCommitment.description: Trusted receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalSentReceiptCommitment.description: Trusted sent receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalReplyCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalReconciliationCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

externalWaiverApprovalCommitment.description: Trusted user receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

batchSizeExceptionCommitment.description: Trusted user receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

eventActorReceiptCommitment.description: Trusted actor receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

timestamp.description: Strict UTC Z timestamp. The invariant checker must also perform semantic calendar validation; format alone is not treated as an assertion.

root_id.description: Only the current repository root may participate in a public locator, and only together with PLANE-REPO-HEAD.

plane_id.description: Only committed HEAD evidence may expose a repo-relative locator. Git refs/history, index, dirty/worktree surfaces, external roots, anchored PRD, archives, Vaults, transcripts, memory, and backups remain opaque.

relative_path.description: POSIX repo-relative BMP path only. The schema rejects C0/C1 controls, surrogate/astral code points, Unicode format controls including bidi controls, and Unicode noncharacters. The invariant checker must additionally require NFC, re-evaluate every scalar value with the pinned Unicode general-category allowlist, reject General_Category=Cf and all bidi/noncharacter code points, resolve the path beneath the declared public root, and verify canonical public evidence.

record_revision.description: Append-only SourceOccurrence record revision. LedgerEvent.subject_revision must equal this value.

source_binding_id.description: Opaque A01 SourceBinding identifier. The invariant checker must resolve exactly one binding and verify that its source_object_id and locator_token match this occurrence.

occurrence_ids.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by opaque occurrence ID ascending.

evidence_refs.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by evidence_id ascending; duplicate evidence_id values are rejected by the invariant checker.

supersedes.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by annotation ID ascending.

superseded_by.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by annotation ID ascending.

aliases.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by opaque alias ID ascending.

sensitive_category_codes.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by enum token ascending.

record_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A02-RECORD/v2\0 || JCS(UTF-8 atomic annotation)) after omitting record_payload_sha256 itself. The written \0 denotes one NUL byte. The invariant checker recomputes it.

record_revision.description: Append-only ExternalReviewBatch record revision. LedgerEvent.subject_revision must equal this value.

annotation_revision_refs.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by annotation_id then annotation_revision ascending. The checker rejects duplicate annotation_id/revision keys and missing or ineligible refs.

destination_session_token.description: Opaque public token for the exact ChatGPT conversation/session receipt. It is null before transmission and required from sent onward; no URL, title, prompt, reply, account identifier, or reversible locator is permitted.

terminal_from_state.description: For superseded/invalidated only, records the exact last nonterminal state whose receipts, commitments, and timestamps must remain intact.

record_revision.description: Append-only ExternalReviewWaiver record revision. LedgerEvent.subject_revision must equal this value.

ledger_sequence.description: Global append-only order. The invariant checker requires exact contiguous values 1..N in array order and binds genesis/previous_event_sha256 accordingly.

subject_revision.description: Must equal payload_after.annotation_revision for atomic-annotation and payload_after.record_revision for every other subject kind; the invariant checker enforces equality and monotonic append-only revision history.

payload_after_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A02-RECORD/v2\0 || JCS(UTF-8 payload_after)) under hash_profile_id. The written \0 denotes one NUL byte; payload_after is retained, so this digest alone is never treated as replay evidence.

event_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A02-EVENT/v2\0 || JCS(UTF-8 event)) after omitting event_payload_sha256 itself. The written \0 denotes one NUL byte.

invariantCheck.description: Declaration of the mandatory second gate after JSON Schema. The content-addressed checker executable must recompute every frozen SHA/HMAC, validate canonical array order and unique business keys, prove A01 occurrence coverage and every cross-reference, resolve each source_occurrence.source_binding_id to exactly one A01 SourceBinding whose source_object_id and locator_token match and reject missing or ambiguous joins, enforce duplicate/supersedes acyclicity, require ledger_sequence 1..N plus previous-event chain continuity, match subject_id/subject_revision/payload_after, replay genesis plus ordered events byte-for-byte to the materialized arrays, validate trusted receipts and monotonic state timestamps, prove reviewed XOR current-revision waiver for every terminal eligible atom, require openai-chatgpt/chatgpt, bind every sent-or-later destination_session_token to the exact trusted sent receipt and preserve that session receipt through terminal transitions, require equal prepared/approved/sent pack commitments, and reject P4/prohibited-secret batch membership or any public/private canary. A self-asserted state=pass without a successful invocation of the executable identified by checker_executable_sha256 is not an acceptance gate.

checker_executable_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact invariant-checker executable artifact. This is null only when state=not-run and is mandatory for pass/fail so checker_id plus checker_version cannot silently drift.
